image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a weasel's head and upper neck in profile, facing right. The animal has golden-brown fur on its dorsal side and lighter cream/white fur on its ventral side (throat/chin). It features a pointed snout, small dark eye, short rounded ear, and visible whiskers. The background is a soft-focus bokeh of grey rock and dark shadows.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Small triangular head with pointed snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular tapering to a distinct, pointed snout, matching the taxonomy description perfectly.
The visible eye is small, round, and black/dark brown, consistent with the species.
The ear is visible, short, and has a rounded tip, blending slightly into the head fur as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Extremely elongated slender body with remarkably fine, diminutive proportions and lightweight build.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the head and neck are visible; the full body length and proportions cannot be verified from this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short dense fur in brown dorsally with white or yellow ventral coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears dense and short. There is a clear color demarcation with brown on top and lighter cream/white on the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some species turn white in winter (ermine morph).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal displays summer coloring (brown/cream), not the full white winter coat. This is a valid state for the class, but the specific 'white' checkpoint is not present.
The visible portion of the neck shows significant length relative to the head size, characteristic of mustelids.
Legs are completely out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short tail relative to body length.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of species identity against ImageNet classes to rule out misclassification (e.g., stoat vs. weasel vs. mink).
To detect subtle AI artifacts in fur generation, such as clumping, unnatural shine, or edge bleeding against the bokeh background.
Whiskers and ear boundaries are high-risk areas for AI fusion or melting; segmentation will verify clean separation from background.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency and strand definition
Boundary sharpness between subject and bokeh background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the whiskers. AI often fails to render individual thin whiskers correctly, causing them to merge with the background or the snout. Verify if the eye catchlight is physically consistent with the lighting direction implied by the shadows on the neck.
